info.name: Microsoft Azure Put  Name Manifests Reference

params.name: name

info.name: Microsoft Azure Delete  Name Manifests Reference

params.description: Name of the image (including the namespace)

params.name: reference

items.docs: Delete the manifest identified by `name` and `reference`. Note that a manifest can _only_ be deleted by `digest`.
